reader.requirement: At --std 85 a figurative constant delimiter (SPACE/SPACES, ZERO/ZEROS/ZEROES, QUOTE/QUOTES, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE, a symbolic-character) is one character; under the ALL phrase one or more contiguous occurrences of the literal (figurative or not, of any length) or of identifier-2's content count as one, and one occurrence goes to DELIMITER IN.
reader.edition-search: grep -i 'edition|version|dialect|DialectLevel' over StringUnstringBinder.cs, StringEmitter.cs, CobolStringOps.cs, OperandText.cs, FigurativeConstants.cs; grep -i 'unstring|delimit' over ConstructRegistry.g.cs and VersionConformancePass.cs. The binder's ctx.Edition uses are BoundRejected.Report/BoundOperandError.Report (the diagnostic channel, fixed EditionSeverity.Error) and ctx.Edition.At (the diagnostic cursor); neither switches behaviour. The only UNSTRING construct gate is unstring-sender-reference-modified-2002 (the sender, not this rule).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf02_05 covers SPACE, ZERO and ALL "*"; ALL over a multi-character literal and over an identifier, QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE, plural figuratives after ALL, a symbolic-character with and without ALL, and an ALL run ending the sender are not exercised

probes.expected: GR8: ALL "ab" collapses "ababab" to one, DELIMITER IN gets one "ab", and the pointer passes the whole run; without ALL, contiguous occurrences leave empty fields; QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE and ZERO are single characters; an ALL SPACES run at the end exhausts the sender (no overflow, R3 untouched)
a symbolic-character (SYMBOLIC CHARACTERS STAR IS 43) is a one-character figurative; ALL STAR collapses the run

probes.printed: COBOL1651 the delimiter 'ALL ","' is a figurative constant that begins with the word ALL

OK  §1985:VI.6.27.4 GR8  the text is in GR8 (quoted: "are treated as if they were only one occurrence")

reader.notes: When the grammar reads an ALL figurative in a delimiter, the binder turns it into the ALL phrase over the plain literal. OperandText.AsString renders a figurative as its one character in identifier-1's category, and UnstringSkipRun consumes the contiguous repeats after the single occurrence UnstringExtract matched. No edition arm on this path.

refuter.evidence: hv1.cob/hv3.cob: PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS REV, ALPHABET REV IS 256 THRU 1, SYMBOLIC CHARACTERS CNUL CFF ARE 1 256. LOW-VALUE resolves to CFF (ORD 001) and UNSTRING ... DELIMITED BY LOW-VALUE finds it at position 6 (C1=05 C2=02), as §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 requires. HIGH-VALUE resolves to a character of ordinal 536 (the implementation's native set extends past 256, and unlisted characters follow the listed ones), so DELIMITED BY HIGH-VALUE and ALL HIGH-VALUES match nothing in the sender (C1=08). That agrees with MOVE HIGH-VALUE and with the alphabet rule, so UNSTRING uses the one figurative value. u_b62ca0/u_2e3108: "OR ALL HIGH-VALUES" and "ALL ZEROES OR ALL QUOTES" are accepted at 85. u3 T1/T2: ALL "*" collapses a run and puts one "*" into DELIMITER IN. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.27.4 GR8 ("it stands for a single character nonnumeric literal"); OK §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 ("the actual characters associated with each figurative constant depend upon the program collating sequence").
